answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 8 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 890 identities costs 890 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. The falcon of the quote is the proof, the plume of the refresh is the expiry, and the kernel of the burn is the penalty.
